date_far_future: {date} is more than two years from now. If that's right, save it anyway.
startup_blocked_title: Moneta is open in another tab
startup_blocked_body: Your budget can only be open in one tab at a time.
startup_blocked_stuck: The other tab didn't hand Moneta over. It may be frozen in the background: close it and try again, or open Moneta here anyway.
startup_force_body: The other tab stops using your budgets. If it is still working, what it hasn't saved yet is lost, and this tab may fail to open until that tab is closed.
crash_body: Nothing was changed. Go to Settings to switch, restore or delete a budget, or reload the app.
update_available: A new version of Moneta is available.
update_downloading: Downloading a new version of Moneta…
welcome_tagline: Zero-based envelope budgeting that never leaves your device.
welcome_point_open: Free and open source, under the MIT license.
welcome_point_private: No account and no server. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
welcome_point_offline: Install it and the whole app, budget and all, works offline.
welcome_browser_body: In a browser tab, your budget is kept as this website's data: the browser may clear it to free up space, and Safari may clear it if you don't open Moneta for a week. Installed, Moneta is better protected and works offline.
welcome_browser_backup: If you stay in the browser, back up regularly from Settings.
welcome_installed_body: Open it from your home screen or app list. Moneta can only be open in one place at a time, so if you stay in this tab the installed app won't open.
welcome_help_ios: Tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.
welcome_help_safari: Open the File menu, then “Add to Dock”.
welcome_help_generic: Look for “Install” or “Add to Home Screen” in your browser's menu.
demo_banner_body: Demo data. Nothing here is saved.
startup_storage_unavailable_body: Moneta keeps your budget in this browser's private storage, which isn't available here. Private windows and some older browsers block it.
startup_quota_body: The browser has no space left for your budget. Free up space on this device and reload.
startup_schema_title: This budget needs a newer Moneta
startup_schema_body: It was saved by a newer version of the app. Reload to update.
startup_worker_body: Something went wrong in the background. Reload to continue; your data is safe.
startup_internal_body: An unexpected error happened while opening your budget.
startup_unreadable_body: Moneta couldn't read the files below. They may be damaged, but nothing was deleted. Restore a backup, start a new budget, or delete a file for good.
startup_skipped: Couldn't open {names}. It may be damaged; you can delete it in Settings.
error_invalid_input: Some of the values aren't valid.
error_already_initialized: This budget is already set up.
error_schema_too_new: This budget was saved by a newer version of Moneta.
error_account_closed: This account is closed. Reopen it to make changes.
error_account_has_transactions: Accounts with transactions can't be deleted. Close it instead.
error_account_balance_not_zero: Only accounts with a zero balance can be closed.
error_category_not_allowed: That category can't be used here.
error_system_entity_readonly: Built-in groups and categories can't be changed.
error_group_not_empty: Move or delete this group's categories first.
error_reassign_required: This category is in use. Choose where its transactions and money go.
error_split_too_few_lines: A split needs at least two lines.
error_split_sum_mismatch: The split lines must add up to the amount.
error_transfer_invalid: Choose another account to transfer to.
error_backup_not_recognized: That file isn't a Moneta backup (.moneta or .sqlite).
error_backup_damaged: That backup is damaged and can't be restored.
error_backup_not_moneta: That database isn't a Moneta budget.
error_backup_too_new: That backup was made by a newer version of Moneta. Update the app to restore it.
error_backup_encrypted: That backup is encrypted. Enter its password or recovery key to restore it.
error_backup_wrong_key: That doesn't open this backup. Check the password or recovery key.
error_backup_keys_unavailable: This browser couldn't read the backup key, so it can't tell whether backups should be encrypted.
error_cloud_auth_needed: Moneta lost access to your cloud storage. Connect again to keep backing up.
error_cloud_permission_denied: Moneta needs permission to save files in your cloud storage. Connect again and allow it.
error_cloud_popup_blocked: The browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for Moneta and try again.
error_cloud_unavailable: Couldn't reach your cloud storage. Moneta will try again when you're online.
error_cloud_storage_full: Your cloud storage is full, so the backup couldn't be saved.
error_cloud_not_encrypted: Backups to the cloud are always encrypted. Turn on backup encryption first.
error_cloud_failed: Your cloud storage gave an answer Moneta didn't expect.
error_restore_partial: The restore stopped partway. The budgets restored before the error were kept; the others were left as they were.
error_currency_locked: This budget already has amounts in it, so its currency can only change to one with the same number of decimal places.
error_worker_failed: The database stopped. Reload to continue.
form_error_amount_invalid: Enter a valid amount, like 12.50 or 10+5.
form_error_split_line_invalid: Every split line needs a category and an amount.
onboarding_welcome_body: Moneta is a zero-based budget: you give every unit of money a job before you spend it. Before you start, here is how it works.
onboarding_welcome_point_browser: It runs entirely in this browser. There is nothing to install and nothing to sign up for.
onboarding_welcome_point_private: There is no account and no server. Nobody else can see your budget, and there is no tracking.
onboarding_welcome_point_device: Your budget is a database file in this browser's private storage. It never leaves this device on its own.
onboarding_backups_body: Keeping everything on your device is the whole point, but it means nobody is keeping a copy for you.
onboarding_backups_point_only_here: The budget lives only in this browser. Clearing the site's data, or losing the device, loses it.
onboarding_backups_point_file: A backup is every budget in one .moneta file. Save one every couple of weeks and keep it somewhere else.
onboarding_backups_point_reminder: Moneta reminds you when your last backup is more than two weeks old.
onboarding_restore_hint: If you used Moneta before, restore your .moneta file (or an older .sqlite one) now to keep your data and skip the rest of the setup.
onboarding_categories_intro: Pick the ones you want to start with. You can add, rename and reorder them later.
onboarding_categories_income_hint: Always created, even with nothing picked.
onboarding_account_intro: You can also start without one and add accounts later.
onboarding_done_body: Your budget is ready. Assign the money you have to your categories, then record what you spend.
onboarding_done_backup_hint: When you're ready for a backup, it's in Settings under Backup, on the "Back up now" button.
account_creation_type_prompt: What type of account are you adding?
account_category_budget_description: Accounts you plan to spend from in the near future.
account_category_tracking_description: Accounts not used for daily spending, tracked for net worth.
account_type_checking_desc: Everyday spending and bills (checking, debit cards).
account_type_savings_desc: Money saved for goals and emergency funds.
account_type_cash_desc: Physical cash in your wallet or envelopes.
account_type_credit_card_desc: Cards used for purchases with payments budgeted.
account_type_loan_desc: Mortgages, student, car, or personal loans.
account_type_other_desc: Other assets or liabilities to monitor.
account_on_budget_hint: Its money is budgeted in categories.
account_off_budget_hint: Tracked for net worth only, not budgeted.
account_close_hint: Closing needs a zero balance. Closed accounts keep their history.
account_delete_hint: Only accounts without transactions can be deleted.
budget_rta_assigned_hint: All your money has a job.
budget_rta_unassigned_hint: Assign this money to your categories.
budget_rta_overassigned_hint: You assigned more than you have. Take some back from a category.
budget_future_negative_body: Ready to Assign goes negative in {month}. Assign less in future months.
category_carryover_hint: Keep a negative balance in this category next month instead of taking it from Ready to Assign.
category_card_payment_note: This category follows its credit card: rename or close the card instead.
category_delete_unused: No transactions or assigned money use this category.
category_delete_in_use_body: Its transactions and all the money assigned to it move to the category you choose.
group_delete_has_categories_body: They move, with their transactions and money, to the end of the group you choose.
group_system_note: This group is managed by Moneta.
order_hint: Drag by the handles or use the arrows.
register_search: Search name, category, memo or amount
reports_net_worth_single_month: Pick a longer period to see the trend.
reports_net_worth_one_month: This budget only covers one month so far. The chart appears once there is a second.
reports_age_of_money_not_enough: It shows up after 10 payments out of your checking, savings or cash accounts.
reports_age_of_money_about: How long your money sat in your accounts before you spent it, on average over your last 10 payments out of checking, savings or cash. Card purchases count when you pay the card.
budget_delete_warning: This deletes {name} and its saved copies for good. Back it up first if you might need it.
wipe_row: Delete all data on this device
wipe_title: Delete all data on this device?
wipe_warning: This deletes every budget, every saved copy and the backup key on this device, and forgets your settings here. Budgets you backed up can be restored from their backup files; nothing else can bring them back.
backup_hint: A backup is every budget on this device in one .moneta file. Keep it somewhere safe, off this device.
backup_restore_replace_warning: This replaces everything in {names} with the backup. Make sure it is the right file.
backup_restore_replace_hint: Budgets already on this device are replaced by the backup. What they hold now is kept under Saved copies, in Settings.
backup_restore_partial: The restore stopped partway. Restored: {names}. The others were left as they were.
backup_demo: The demo isn't saved, so it has no backups or exports.
backup_copies_hint: Moneta saves a copy of a budget before an app update changes how it is stored, and when a restored backup replaces it. If something looks wrong, restore one as a new budget.
backup_copy_restore_named: Restore the copy saved {date} as a new budget
backup_copy_restored: Copy restored as a new budget.
backup_exports_hint: For spreadsheets and other apps. These files can't be restored.
backup_exports_hint_encrypted: For spreadsheets and other apps. These files can't be restored, and exports are not encrypted: keep them somewhere safe.
backup_reminder: Your last backup is more than two weeks old.
backup_skipped: Couldn't back up {names}. The other budgets are in the backup.
backup_encrypt_on_hint: Restoring a backup needs your password or recovery key.
backup_encrypt_off_hint: Anyone with a backup file can read it.
backup_encrypt_intro: Backups made from now on need this password or your recovery key to restore. Moneta keeps a key on this device, so backing up won't ask for it.
backup_encrypted_off: Backups are no longer encrypted. The ones made before still need their password.
backup_change_intro: Backups made before keep their old password and recovery key.
backup_password_weak: This password is too easy to guess. A few unrelated words make one that is hard to guess and easy to remember.
backup_password_hint: The recovery key is strong by design; the password is what someone holding a backup would try to guess.
backup_recovery_hint: If you forget the password, this key is the only way to open these backups. Keep it apart from your backups: in a password manager, or printed.
backup_check_hint: Make sure you still remember the password your backups need.
backup_check_wrong: That's not the password your backups use.
backup_unlock_hint: Enter the password it was made with, or its recovery key.
storage_persisted_hint: The browser won't clear your budget to free up space. It only goes if you clear this site's data.
storage_ask_hint: If the device runs low on space, the browser may clear your budget.
storage_blocked_hint: You declined, so the browser may clear your budget if space runs low. To allow it, open the site information (the icon left of the address), remove the block on persistent storage, then tap Try again.
storage_automatic_hint: This browser decides by itself which sites to protect, and usually protects installed apps.
storage_unsupported_hint: This browser can't protect your data from being cleared.
storage_backup_hint: Back up regularly so you can restore your budget if it's cleared.
not_found_body: This address doesn't exist in Moneta.
payees_empty: No payees yet. They're added as you enter transactions.
payees_remove_unused_body: Payees with no transactions will be deleted ({count}). A payee comes back if you type it in a transaction again.
payee_exists: “{name}” already exists. Merge this payee into it instead?
payee_default_category_hint: New transactions with this payee start with it. Without one, the last category used is suggested.
payee_merge_body: The transactions of “{from}” move to “{to}”, and “{from}” is deleted.
payee_merge_hint: Its transactions move to the chosen payee, and this one is deleted.
payee_delete_body: It comes back if you type it in a transaction again.
payee_in_use_hint: It has transactions, so it can't be deleted. Merge it into another payee instead.
error_payee_exists: A payee with this name already exists.
error_payee_in_use: This payee has transactions. Merge it into another payee instead.
error_schedule_stale: This occurrence was already entered or skipped.
schedules_empty: No schedules yet. Add one for bills and income that repeat.
schedule_auto_enter_hint: Moneta enters it on its date, the next time the app is open.
schedule_manual_hint: It waits in the account as due until you enter or skip it.
schedule_enter_many_body: This automatic schedule is already due {count} times. Saving it enters {count} transactions now, each on its own date. Check the date if that isn't what you meant.
schedule_delete_body: Transactions it already entered stay in the account.
form_error_interval_invalid: Enter a whole number, 1 or more.
form_error_end_date_invalid: The end date must be on or after the next date.
form_error_end_count_invalid: Enter how many times, 1 or more.
reports_customize_hint: Drag by the handles or use the arrows. Switch a report off to hide it.
reports_income_expense_empty: No income or expenses in this period.
reports_accounts_empty: No open accounts with a balance.
cloud_hint: While Moneta is open, it saves an encrypted backup to your own cloud storage by itself. The last {count} days are kept.
cloud_disconnect_body: Automatic backups stop. The backups already saved stay in your {provider}, in the Moneta folder.
cloud_disconnect_first: Backups to {provider} are always encrypted. Disconnect it before turning encryption off.
cloud_restore_hint: Backups Moneta saved in your {provider}, newest first.
cloud_restore_connect_hint: Sign in to see the backups saved there.
cloud_restore_empty: There are no Moneta backups in this {provider} yet.
cloud_callback_body: You can close this window and go back to Moneta.
onboarding_backups_point_cloud: Moneta can also back up to your own cloud storage by itself, encrypted. Turn it on in Settings, under Backup.
